definition: Primary: absolute normalized Hilbert-Schmidt overlap of signed transition kernel sqrt(2)*Cocc*(X+Y)*Cvirt.T. Independent reconstructed dipole/f checks coefficient and orbital alignment. NTO hole/electron reduced-density overlap (>99.5% pair weight) is an additional phase-insensitive diagnostic, not unique state identity. Exact AO integrals on public heavy-atom mapped, properly rotated nuclei; ambiguous roots retained.
basis_reconstruction: Every fchk primitive/contraction, SP split, Gaussian5D -> PySCF spherical order; native MO/NTO orthonormality and rotated AO overlap independently checked.
